key_insight: A graph-guided Mixture of Experts framework can better combine multi-modal cancer data for survival prediction than single-modality or vanilla ensemble approaches.
clinical_relevance: This approach could improve prognostic modeling in oncology by handling missing or heterogeneous inputs such as clinical records, pathology slides, and genomics.
method: Uses a graph structure to coordinate expert models and route predictions.
Treats existing modality-specific models as tools instead of training one end-to-end foundation model.
Applies a MoE-guided ensemble to integrate multiple modalities for tumor survival prediction.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved performance on the TCGA-LUAD dataset compared with individual modality models and vanilla ensemble baselines.
watch_item: Performance gains are shown on one dataset, so broader validation is needed to confirm robustness across cancer types and real-world missing-modality settings.
paper_title: Multi-Modal Tumor Survival Prediction via Graph-Guided Mixture of Experts
